notes: A new user is welcomed with **Build the showcase project**: the E-Bike Share example now shows off everything added lately: a discussion that became a decision (with badges on what it affects), an open thread and a proposed decision, a formal document made from a template with one figure filled and the rest waiting, a live section and a live query table in the specification, a review of the specification in place (section verdicts and a margin comment), two diagrams generated from the model, a locked card, a structure diagram that changed since the baseline (try Compare), roadmap milestones with a scope, a wide note in Adaptive width and a saved workspace. Building it opens "Feature tour: start here", which ends with ten minutes of things to try.
